claims.text: Prisca was the second child and daughter of Polo Baggins. She married Wilibald Bolger, and had several children: Wilimar, Heribald and Nora. Her husband passed away before , but she attended Bilbo's Farewell Party with her children.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Baggins of Hobbiton"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings (50th Anniv. Ed.), Appendix C, "Bolger of Budgeford"

claims.text:
The 50th Anniversary edition of The Lord of the Rings includes Prisca as a guest at the Farewell Party. In older editions of Appendix C, Prisca is not marked as an attendee. Robert Foster in his The Complete Guide to Middle-earth thus states that Prisca died before .
